# 💚 eSaha - Mental Health Platform

**Comprehensive mental health and wellness platform with secure chat, journaling, and appointment management**

## Key Highlights
- Healthcare-focused, privacy-first platform
- Real-time communication with professionals
- Secure data handling and accessibility-focused design

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons
- State: React Context API
- Routing: React Router
- Backend: Supabase (Auth, DB, Storage)
- HTTP Client: Axios

## Core Features
- Secure authentication and protected routes
- Specialist directory for browsing professionals
- Real-time chat with providers
- Private journaling for progress tracking
- Appointment scheduling with calendar
- Emergency contacts management
- Resources library and user settings

## Healthcare Considerations
- Privacy compliance for healthcare data
- Secure communications and storage
- Accessible, user-centered UX
- Scalable Supabase-backed architecture

## Skills Demonstrated
- Healthcare software development (privacy, compliance)
- Real-time apps (chat)
- Modern React (Hooks, Context, TypeScript)
- UI/UX design (accessible interfaces)
- Backend integration (Supabase)
